mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.contract_no, c.company_id, cc.company_name, cc.customer_id, ci.customer_name, c.business_id, sb.business_name, c.contract_type, c.contract_start_time, c.contract_end_time, c.contract_price, c.have_order, c.have_address, c.status, c.transfer_task, c.remark, c.create_by_name, c.create_time, c.tenant_id, c.deleted, c.contract_file_url, wo.id AS work_order_id, wo.task_no AS work_order_no FROM contract c LEFT JOIN customer_company cc ON c.company_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON cc.customer_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN sys_business sb ON c.business_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN work_order wo ON wo.contract_id = c.id AND wo.deleted = 0 AND wo.parent_task_id IS NULL AND wo.status <> 'CANCELED' AND wo.id = ( SELECT MAX(wo2.id) FROM work_order wo2 WHERE wo2.contract_id = c.id AND wo2.deleted = 0 AND wo2.parent_task_id IS NULL AND wo2.status <> 'CANCELED' ) WHERE c.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT c.company_id FROM contract c INNER JOIN sys_business sb ON sb.id = c.business_id AND sb.deleted = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND sb.business_name IN
#{name}
